title: Bridge closing card
description: A closing call to action: a wide white card with soft rounded corners floats on a blurred sky-and-seafoam band that fades out at the top and bottom. Inside, one dark line and one grey line in the same large regular weight, with a small underline link at the top right (under the lines on phones).
notes: backdrop slot: a blurred photo band (the original's is 2000×736, cover); a soft wash when empty
the card uses the card token, so on dark themes it reads as a dark panel on the band
name: bridge-cta

props.name: backdrop
props.description: a blurred photo band behind the card, faded at top and bottom; a soft wash when empty
